subject: Catalyst Health — Acquisition Credit + Pilot Bundle Exception (VP/CFO signoff needed)
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@catalyst-health.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-06T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request — acquisition credit for pilot bundle

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We moved faster than expected on the internal approval side — acquisition team confirmed they'd like to run a 6-week pilot covering 2 production connectors and 3 model endpoints. Finance asked if Redwood can provide a one-time acquisition credit to offset our migration costs (engineering time + data mapping).

Rough ask: a $45k one-time credit applied to first invoice, plus pilot pricing locked at the quoted pilot rate. We have the contested compliance checklist on file but will sign an updated DPA/Docusign if that helps.

Attached: Catalyst_Usage_Q3.pdf (shows baseline), Proposed_Pilot_SOW_v2.docx

Can you advise next steps? We need a formal memo to our CFO that shows Redwood's approval path.

Best,
Elena
Head of Procurement
Catalyst Health

---
From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@catalyst-health.com>; procurement@catalyst-health.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-06T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request — acquisition credit for pilot bundle

Elena — appreciate the quick follow. Congrats on the internal green light.

High level: Redwood can make a one-time acquisition credit available, but it requires an internal exception memo and VP/CFO signoff for anything beyond our standard onboarding credit thresholds. To expedite, I'll assemble the business case and proposed guardrails:

- Proposed credit: $45,000 one-time credit applied to first invoice
- Pilot term: 6 weeks, up to 1.2M tokens/month during the pilot at pilot rates
- Guardrails: credit clawback if usage exceeds 3x forecast or if contract not executed within 60 days
- Deliverables: SOW (attached), pilot acceptance criteria, security attestation

I'll loop in Marissa and Kim for commercial and finance validation and put together the exception memo for VP/CFO review. If you can confirm exact SOW start date and PO number (if any) that speeds us up.

— Logan
Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-06T12:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request — acquisition credit for pilot bundle

Logan — thanks. Quick notes from commercial: the ask sits outside standard pilot credits because of size and the customer is requesting credit applied as an invoice line (not an uplift or discount). We need:

1) A short business case (1 pager) that shows CAC rationale and expected ARR conversion probability.
2) A clear clawback/true-up mechanism and a maximum credit cap (we should consider $45k hard cap).
3) Confirmation that this is a single-use exception (i.e., not precedent).

Aditya — can you run revenue impact modeling and probability? Kim — can you confirm finance acceptance of the clawback language? I'll draft the exception memo once we have the numbers.

-M
Commercial Ops
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-06T15:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request — acquisition credit for pilot bundle

Attached the model (Pricing_Workup_Catalyst.xlsx). Quick summary:
- Expected 12-month ARR if converted: $540k (base + seats + extra endpoints)
- Conversion probability: 35% (mid-case) — expected value ~ $189k ARR
- NPV (3 year): ~$360k against $45k credit cost

Recommendation: approve one-time $45k credit with 75% clawback if no signed contract within 90 days or if usage > 3x forecast during pilot. Also recommend we require PO or signed letter of intent to avoid administrative overhead.

If Kim signs off on clawback language, Marissa can finalize the exception memo for VP/CFO signoff.

-A
Finance Analyst
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-07T16:34:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Request — Request — acquisition credit for pilot bundle (approval path memo ready)

Team — I've reviewed the workup and attachments. Finance is comfortable with the $45k hard cap and the proposed clawback (75% within 90 days). A couple of legal/ops caveats to include in the memo:

- Credit will be issued as a contra line on invoice #1 and must be offset before recognizing any deferred revenue related to the pilot conversion.
- We need a signed SOW and the customer's PO or LOI before we apply the credit.
- If contract execution slips beyond 120 days, the credit is voidable and will be reversed on the next invoice.

Marissa — I've attached suggested language below you can paste into the memo. Recommend we route the memo to VP Sales (Marissa) and CFO (Aditya to copy CFO alias) for signoff.

Suggested finance language snippet:
"Redwood will provide a one-time acquisition credit not to exceed $45,000 (hard cap). The credit is conditional on execution of a signed SOW and receipt of a customer PO/LOI. A clawback of 75% applies if a signed contract is not executed within 90 days, and the credit will be reversed if execution exceeds 120 days. All credits issued under this exception will be recorded as contra revenue per Redwood accounting policy."

I'm available for a quick call if needed.

-Kim
Director, Finance (Revenue Ops)
